what: The machines of docs/SUPPORT.md "Tested configurations": per machine the GPU, CPU, driver and toolkit, the package revision built from source, and each check with its result line, transcribed from the integration-test logs (numbers as recorded). The bit-identity check compares the installed package with a separately built library of the same decoder sources on corpora of the bb72 z, bb144 xyz and hgp98 z problems at a03125c3 and ms30 (2,000 shots per row); the forced-AVX2 run covers bb144 xyz at both configs (500 shots per row). No latency is quoted from these machines except the --quick benchmark screen of the RTX 5090 fresh-clone install test, which is labelled as a screen; the wall-clock times of the fresh-clone tests are approximate. The RTX 5090 and RTX 3090 entries are transcribed from those fresh-clone install tests' step logs and their verify, bench and tuner records (paths, host and user names removed). The RTX 3090 (compute capability 8.6) is not a supported GPU: its entry records the build with CUDA 13.0 and the CPU-core checks.
